scope: Physical BOOT gestures observed through unsigned diagnostic HID; not the separate-button hold ceremony or secure-element signing acceptance.
source_commit_scope: Host diagnostic source used for the physical tests; firmware version is reported over unsigned HID, not attested.
retained_failures: A retry found the board in RP2 Boot mode; only that USB device was restarted into its installed application. No firmware was flashed.
The first NO attempt rejected a mismatched diagnostic challenge. One queued status reply was drained before the successful retry.
production_acceptance_limits: These are unsigned BOOT-button diagnostics, not signed approval or denial.
Separate YES/NO buttons and the specified deliberate YES hold have not been physically accepted.
No secure-element key generation, enrollment, signature, monotonic counter or signed replay demonstration was performed.
